enrollment_discounts_value_chk.name: enrollment_discounts_value_chk
enrollment_discounts_value_chk.value: ("enrollment_discounts"."type" = 'FREE' and "enrollment_discounts"."value" is null) or ("enrollment_discounts"."type" = 'PERCENT' and "enrollment_discounts"."value" is not null and "enrollment_discounts"."value" between 1 and 100) or ("enrollment_discounts"."type" = 'AMOUNT' and "enrollment_discounts"."value" is not null and "enrollment_discounts"."value" > 0)

enrollment_discounts_dates_chk.name: enrollment_discounts_dates_chk
enrollment_discounts_dates_chk.value: "enrollment_discounts"."to_date" is null or "enrollment_discounts"."from_date" is null or "enrollment_discounts"."to_date" >= "enrollment_discounts"."from_date"

groups_billing_day_chk.name: groups_billing_day_chk
groups_billing_day_chk.value: ("groups"."billing_mode" = 'GROUP_CYCLE' and "groups"."billing_day" is not null and "groups"."billing_day" between 1 and 28) or ("groups"."billing_mode" = 'STUDENT_CYCLE' and "groups"."billing_day" is null)

groups_dates_chk.name: groups_dates_chk
groups_dates_chk.value: "groups"."end_date" is null or "groups"."start_date" is null or "groups"."end_date" >= "groups"."start_date"
